note: Family-owned rural campground (est. 2012) near Williamston; ~35-40 large sites, many pull-throughs, big rigs OK. Walking/horse trails, propane. --Claude
summary: Operating (site (c) 2026, Google 4.5 over 98 reviews). Confirmed full hookups (water/sewer), year-round, camp store; added showers, Wi-Fi, phone/email reservations. No posted rate; priced only by RV Life $$ (an ordinary transient park, so that stands in). Not stated: electric amperage, pull-throughs, site count (35 vs 40 on two pages). Note trimmed of hookups, store and year-round.
flags: No posted nightly rate and no booking engine (call or email). It reads as an ordinary transient campground ('Stop over for a break on your seasonal trip north or south'), so presence (website + phone; Google 4.5/98) plus RV Life's $$ tier passes; no long-stay signs found.
Phone: the site also lists an after-hours number, (252) 375-1294; main (252) 789-8482 matches the entry.
